# Callouts

A plain callout:

> [!warning] The winter
> The winter is not discussed further here.

A callout with no title:

> [!info]
> Something worth knowing.

A callout that starts open:

> [!tip]- Open by default
> The body is visible.

A callout that starts closed:

> [!example]+ Closed by default
> The body is hidden until it is clicked.

A type this build has never heard of:

> [!twitch] Stream schedule
> Fridays.

An ordinary quote, which is not a callout:

> Just a quote, with [!warning] written inside it.

A callout inside a list item:

- A list item with a callout in it:

  > [!danger] The toll
  > It has doubled.

A callout whose first line is malformed, which is still a quote:

> [!warning The bracket is unclosed
> So this is a quote.
